title: A morphism locally of finite presentation is of finite presentation on every pair of affine opens
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Then for all affine opens $U\subseteq X$ and $V\subseteq Y$ with $f(U)\subseteq V$, the ring map $\mathcal O_Y(V)\to\mathcal O_X(U)$ induced by $f$ is of finite presentation: $\mathcal O_X(U)\cong\mathcal O_Y(V)[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(g_1,\dots,g_m)$ as $\mathcal O_Y(V)$-algebras for some $n,m\ge0$ (Stacks Morphisms, Lemma 01TQ, (1)$\Rightarrow$(2)).
